# Wallets Requirements Checklist: Wallets & Membership (client)

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 006 — offline-first money records, clashes, roles and the backend contract
**Created**: 2026-10-02
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Focus (assumed default, owner away): offline/sync correctness and money/contract fidelity, standard depth, audience = PR reviewer. Items found as gaps were fixed in the spec in the same session; each says where.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are loading, empty and refresh-failure states of the wallet list all specified, and distinguished from each other? [Gap → fixed: FR-007 loading state and failed refresh; US2-S6 empty]
- [x] CHK002 Is the base version of an edit defined when a refresh lands while the person is editing? [Gap → fixed: FR-010 "version shown when the editor was opened"]
- [x] CHK003 Are the conditions for offering "Transfer ownership" complete (role, other member, waiting change, confirmation)? [Gap → fixed: FR-023]
- [x] CHK004 Is the behaviour defined when the wallet open on screen disappears after a refresh? [Gap → fixed: Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Is the behaviour defined for a wallet type value the app doesn't know? [Gap → fixed: Edge Cases, data-model §1]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for how an archive and a field edit made offline reach the server together without either being lost? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases, research R-04]
- [ ] CHK007 Are the refusal reasons and the actions offered for each (edit, try again, discard) enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the scope of local deletion ("everything recorded in it") defined for data that later features add? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, contracts/wallets-domain.md]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "balance adjusted by changes still on this phone" defined precisely enough to compute? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, research R-10]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the counting rule for the `wallets.max` gate (which wallets count) unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the ordering of wallets and of totals specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, research R-11]
- [ ] CHK012 Is "amount owed" entry for liabilities specified including sign and zero? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013, Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the fixed icon and colour sets named, and is "none" defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, research R-13]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do the archive rules (one-way, editable after, excluded from totals) agree across US4, FR-003 and FR-019? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK015 Are clash choices consistent with spec 004 (keep mine / use theirs) and with the backend's final deletion (no restore)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016–FR-017, spec 004 FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Does role gating in the spec match the backend's permission matrix for wallet writes (owner-only edit, archive, delete, transfer)? [Consistency, Spec §6, backend spec 010 §6]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the use of PUT only (no PATCH) consistent with the brief's "Consumes" list, and is the deviation recorded? [Consistency, Spec §5, research R-05]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK018 Can SC-005 (50 wallets within 1 s) be measured with the planned tests? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK019 Does every acceptance scenario name an observable outcome (text, mark, server state)? [Measurability, Spec §8]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are recovery paths covered for every clash kind: edit vs live, edit vs deleted, delete vs live? [Coverage, Spec US3-S5..S7, US4-S6]
- [ ] CHK021 Are refusals by the server for stale local knowledge (not verified, plan) covered by a recovery action? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases, FR-018]
- [ ] CHK022 Are the brief's integration-checkpoint scenarios (offline create syncs; second-session edit shows; stale edit clashes) each traced to an acceptance scenario? [Coverage, Spec SC-007 → US1-S3, US2-S4, US3-S5]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are boundary amounts (±2^53−1 minor units, 0- and 3-digit currencies) covered? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Is a wallet created and deleted before its first send covered (nothing sent)? [Edge Case, Spec US4-S5]
- [ ] CHK025 Is the account switch (sign-out, sign-in as someone else) covered for wallet data? [Edge Case, Spec FR-026]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK026 Are accessibility requirements (text not colour, targets, font scale) stated for wallet screens? [Gap → fixed: FR-028]
- [ ] CHK027 Is privacy of other members' data (no email, display name only) required explicitly? [Security, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK028 Are logging limits (no names, amounts or payloads) traceable to a requirement or plan rule? [Security, plan P-09 row]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK029 Is the dependency on C3 (gate, error code, copy, two-part E2E runner) listed with what happens if it slips? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions, plan "Dependencies on C3"]
- [ ] CHK030 Is the wave-2 boundary (change feed, batch upload, membership on the user feed) stated as out of scope? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, §5]
